note: Okabe-Ito, the standard colour-vision-deficient-safe qualitative set. Replaces the bin-lid palette, whose red garbage and green organics were indistinguishable under deuteranopia and protanopia. The bin-lid colours survive on the page as words ('the red-lid bin'), never as an encoding.
source: Okabe M and Ito K, Color Universal Design (2008)
